page.layout: One text column with running head "LATINA." and page number 107 at the top; below the text, a bracketed diagram of the periphrastic future, in one column of boxes with a central "ut" connector.

main_text.p: Ferar, fereris vel ferere, feretur, feremur, feremini, ferentur.
main_text.head: Secundum futurum tempus.
main_text.p: Amatus, Doctus, Lectus, Auditus, Latus ero vel fuero, ich will oder werde / oder soll geliebet / geleh-ret/gelesen/gehöret/getragen werden/eris vel fueris, erit vel fuerit, Amati, docti, lecti, auditi, lati erimus vel fuerimus, eritis vel fueritis, erunt vel fuerint.
main_text.head: Tertium futurum tempus.
main_text.p: Amare vel amator tu, werde du geliebet oder du sollt geliebet werden/ amator ille, amamini vos, amantor illi.
Docere vel docetor tu, docetor ille, docemini vos, docentor illi.
Legere vel legitor tu, legitor ille, legimini vos, le-guntor illi.
Audire vel auditor tu, auditor ille, audimini vos, audiuntor illi.
Ferre vel fertor tu, fertor ille; ferimini vos, feruntor illi.
main_text.head: DE VERBIS INFINITIS.
Præsens & imperfectum tempus.
main_text.p: Amari, geliebet werden. Doceri, gelehret werden. Legi, gelesen werden. Audiri, gehöret werden. Ferri, getragen werden.
Futurum tempus eleganter hoc pacto circumloquimur.

page.notes: The German glosses are in black letter and are marked with bl; the exact extent of the bl spans is uncertain in places. The "ut" connector is set sideways between the brackets and is read as a label. The depth of the right-hand boxes in the diagram is inferred from the brace layout and is not certain. The "ilh" in "amantor illi" and the "ilii" in "docentor illi" are read as printed and may be damaged. No signature, catchword or margin notes are visible.
